changelog:
1.6.1 — The Best Patch So Far
  ADDED: Client sends bossHit packet when its snake lands a boss head-on; host applies the damage and credits the client
  ADDED: New HEALER boss — green gradient snake that stores the normal fruit it eats and releases it as green healing fruit when damaged
  ADDED: Green healing fruit spawned by the HEALER on damage — edible by players and bosses, grows the snake +2, and doesn't count toward the normal food cap
  CHANGED: Boss-defeat score (+25) and growth now credit the snake that landed the killing blow
  CHANGED: Boss teleport avoids player danger zones (head and body); falls back to a random tp that avoids the player body
  CHANGED: Hitting a boss head shrinks the player by 3 segments again (skipped on the killing blow)
  FIXED: Client camera no longer snaps from spectator full view back to the chosen view after both snakes die
  FIXED: Dead-snake view no longer shifts the grid by half a cell
  FIXED: Multiplayer game-over screen now reliably appears — host detects client death via empty-body clientState instead of keeping a ghost snake alive
  FIXED: Client prediction no longer masks its own death as an alive empty-body ghost
  FIXED: Ready system — the host is the sole authority and only starts the match when both players are ready; stale opponent readiness cleared when a client disconnects

1.6.0
  ADDED: Classic game mode — dynamic screen-filling board with static camera, no bosses
  ADDED: Game mode selection screen with Arcade/Classic buttons, mode descriptions, and PLAY button
  ADDED: Separate Arcade and Classic leaderboards with mode selector tabs
  ADDED: Remember last selected game mode across sessions
  CHANGED: Mode selection screen redesigned — select mode first, then press PLAY
  CHANGED: Board dimensions computed dynamically in Classic mode based on device screen size
